name: whatevertools-monorepo
description: Portable runtime for launcher-style desktop plugins: run, package and port plugins written against uTools-like APIs

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/upx packages/db-file packages/db-indexeddb packages/sync-folder packages/sync-http packages/api packages/compat-utools packages/fs-virtual packages/sharp-canvas packages/shim-node packages/shim-electron packages/bridge packages/bridge-server packages/web-files packages/web packages/web-host packages/electron packages/utools packages/cli packages/vite apps/launcher
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/upx packages/db-file packages/db-indexeddb packages/sync-folder packages/sync-http packages/api packages/compat-utools packages/fs-virtual packages/sharp-canvas packages/shim-node packages/shim-electron packages/bridge packages/bridge-server packages/web-files packages/web packages/web-host packages/electron packages/utools packages/cli packages/vite apps/launcher
scripts.test:all: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:pack && pnpm test:vite && pnpm test:sharp && pnpm test:webhost
